arguments.prompt: Create one game sprite as a crisp outlined 2D Cartoon drawing on genuine transparent alpha. Exact pixel-art reference controls silhouette, pose, orientation, visible anatomy and occlusion; diagnostic source palette is not calibrated material color. Do not turn the pose into a generic side-view icon. Preserve all connected parts and the relative lengths/angles shown; no scenery, floor, cast shadow, glow, text or surrounding effects. Keep complete artwork inside canvas with 6% transparent margin, including every fin/claw/leg and any source line. Subject: ONE small red/orange crab, body tilted diagonally from lower-left toward upper-right, exactly as source. One large pincer reaches high above the body near the top center, the other pincer reaches far toward the LEFT. Both pincers have two jaws and source-shaped curved stalks. Keep the small pointed walking legs visibly attached to the right and lower edges of the body in their original directions. The source's black pixels include real legs and pincer outlines; the contact-sheet second reference shows them against light gray. Preserve the original body and appendage count/overlap, rather than inventing a symmetrical frontal crab. Warm red shell with orange/gold highlights, dark black contour and clean cel shading, no extra human-like arms. Face details only if present in source; do not invent large stalked eyes or a smile.
